# Homemade profile

Use this profile for homemade food. The first campaign may feature mooncakes, but never assume that product when the brief names something else.

## Preferred real footage

- Preparing filling, shaping, baking, cutting, close-up texture, boxing, and preparing a real order.
- Warm, appetizing, careful, family-oriented, or gifting-oriented direction when it matches the brief.
- Product-first sensory proof and real process are stronger than generic lifestyle filler.

## Hard boundaries

- Do not infer “clean”, “safe”, “low sugar”, “preservative-free”, health benefits, ingredients, shelf life, or quality grades.
- Do not use an AI image as the real product or as evidence of product appearance.
- Claims about flavor, price, availability, promotion, deadline, delivery, or ordering require a non-empty `brief_path` resolving to the supplied brief.
- If real product media is unavailable, request it. AI may only supply clearly illustrative background or non-product B-roll that creates no commercial claim.
